type.description: The card's one primary type — a theme, not a rulebook.

family.description: Edge tint only. Each value is a .card.family-* rule in styles.css.

ability.description: Marks this a per-member ability card, auto-resolved on the deployed member carrying that ability.

noPotent.description: Opts the card out of the Potent modifier.

engine.description: Marks a mana-economy card (isEngineCard) — the "engine" of the deck, not an engine-code escape hatch.

single.description: Channel ends early if its remembered target dies.

channel.description: A channel ALSO needs an arm in Game._tickChannel and a name in CHANNEL_TICK_CARDS, or it ticks down doing nothing. The validator enforces this.
